what: Plan omits fail-open capture idiom under set -e
scenario_or_breakage: After repointing to python3 session resolve-implement-tmpdir a non-zero CLI exit from IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=$(python3 ...) aborts the script before exit 0 violating the SessionStart must-always-exit-0 contract in sessionstart-health.md:5
suggested_fix: Add an explicit hook requirement: IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=$(python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/python/cli.py" session resolve-implement-tmpdir --cwd "$HOOK_CWD" 2>/dev/null) || IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR="" (or equivalent set +e wrapper) in scripts/sessionstart-health.sh and document it in scripts/sessionstart-health.md
